title: Western Analysis used in Oxidative Stress Protocols
author: Eva Feldman
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8bbhsin
materials: When gel is done gently remove combs.

steps.title: Prepare Gel Rig
steps.instruction: Wash and dry plates, assemble the rig, and fill plates with H2O to check for leaks.

steps.title: Prepare Gel Casting
steps.instruction: Prepare the rig for gel loading and casting.

substeps.instruction: Pour off water and wipe dry with a kimwipe.
Load gel to approximately the top of the door.
Add 2-propanol to cover the edge.
Once the gel is ready, pour off 2-propanol and rinse with H2O.
Remove excess H2O with a kimwipe.

steps.title: Cast Stacking Gel
steps.instruction: Prepare and load the stacking gel and insert the comb, ensuring no bubbles are under the teeth.

steps.title: Prepare Samples
steps.instruction: Process plasma, DRG, and sciatic nerve samples for analysis.

substeps.instruction: For Plasma: Dilute 2µL plasma in 198µL (1:50) RIPA buffer + inhibitors in a labeled screw top tube. Sonicate on 5. Remove 10µL for protein analysis. Add 38µL 10X sample buffer to the 190µL lysate.
For DRG and Sciatic nerve: Pool remaining DRG (after removing 4 for TRAP assay) or place 1 sciatic nerve into a labeled screw top tube. Add 110µL RIPA buffer + inhibitors. Sonicate on 8 on ice.
Freeze, thaw, and run the DRG/Sciatic nerve samples through a 1mL syringe with a 26g needle; repeat the freeze, thaw, and syringe process.
Remove 10µL for protein analysis. Add 20µL 10X sample buffer to the 100µL lysate.

steps.title: Prepare Markers and Boil Samples
steps.instruction: Prepare protein markers and denature all samples.

substeps.instruction: Label screw top tubes for markers.
Add 2µL 10X sample buffer to 10µL rainbow protein marker (repeat for the number of gels used).
Boil samples and markers for 5 minutes and cool.

steps.title: Run Electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Assemble the rig and run the gel to separate proteins.

substeps.instruction: Assemble rig with the short plate on the inside, press down and close doors.
Fill the inside chamber with running buffer to approximately halfway between the top of the small and large plates; check for leaks.
Pour running buffer into the outside of the rig up to the bottom of the gate.
Load the rainbow protein marker and samples (generally load 20 to 50µg).
Set voltage to 200V and run for 50-60 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare Transfer Components
steps.instruction: Prepare the gel and materials for the transfer sandwich.

substeps.instruction: Remove gel from rig, remove wells, and soak gel in transfer buffer for 15 minutes.
Cut and label nitrocellulose membrane to size and soak in transfer buffer.
Soak 2 fiber pads and 2 pieces of Whatman paper per gel in a separate dish.

steps.title: Assemble Transfer Sandwich
steps.instruction: Assemble the transfer sandwich in transfer buffer with the black side down.

substeps.instruction: Layer the components in this order: 1 fiber pad, 1 Whatman paper, gel, nitrocellulose, 1 Whatman paper, and 1 fiber pad.
Ensure there are no bubbles between each layer.

steps.title: Perform Protein Transfer
steps.instruction: Transfer proteins from the gel to the membrane.

substeps.instruction: Place a stir bar in the bottom of the rig and place the sandwich in the transfer unit with the black part in the back.
Fill the ice pack and place it behind the sandwich.
Fill the unit with 1X transfer buffer until the ice pack floats or reaches the top of the lower ledge.
Transfer at 100V for 1 hour (for 100kd-30kd) or 69V for very low proteins.

steps.title: Block Membrane
steps.instruction: Rinse and block the membrane to prevent non-specific binding.

substeps.instruction: Rinse the membrane in 1X TBS for 10 minutes.
Block overnight at 4ºC or for 2 hours at room temperature (RT) in TBST/milk for polyclonal antibodies or TBST/BSA for mAbs.

steps.title: Primary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the membrane with the primary antibody on a rocker.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 2 hours at RT or overnight at 4ºC in primary antibody in TBST/milk or TBST/BSA.

steps.title: Secondary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Wash the membrane and incubate with the secondary antibody.

substeps.instruction: Wash 3 times for 5 minutes each with TBST.
Incubate for 2 hours in secondary antibody in TBST/milk or TBST/BSA.

steps.title: Final Wash and Development
steps.instruction: Perform final washes and develop the membrane.

substeps.instruction: Wash 3 times for 5 minutes each in TBST.
Wash for 20 minutes in 1X TBS.
In a 15mL conical tube, develop using small cell signaling bottles with 9mL H2O and 500µL of each reagent.
Expose for 1 minute.
